newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japanese banks lag in financial technology - BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Japanese banks lag in financial technology - BOJ.

text.p: Japanese banks lag behind their overseas counterparts in financial technology, Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Yasuo Matsushita said on Monday.
Matsushita said that at present, Japanese financial institutions lag behind their counterparts in New York and London in the technology of developing financial instruments and services.

He said Japanese financial institutions have no choice but to strengthen their competitiveness by themselves through competition, and added that unless their competitiveness improved, Japan's economic development would be inhibited.
